headline: Claude gains document creation and Cowork features in chat
summary: Two outlets report Anthropic bringing Cowork capabilities into the Claude chat interface, going first to Pro and Max subscribers. One describes the change as merging two interfaces; the other names what it adds, including editable documents and slideshows.
